newsitem.title: USA: Paxson acquires three TV stations, one radio station.
newsitem.headline: Paxson acquires three TV stations, one radio station.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp. said Thursday it had acquired three television stations and will purchase a radio station in separate deals.
The TV stations are KCMY TV-29, serving the Sacramento, Calif. market; KOOG TV-30, serving the Salt Lake City market; and WNAL TV-44 of Birmingham, Ala.

Paxson said it plans to buy WPVJ 106.5-FM of Jacksonville, Fla., from InterMart Broadcasting First Coast Inc. The deal would expand Paxson's holdings in Jacksonville to six radio stations, including four FM stations and two AM stations.

After completing these and other previously announced acquisitions, Paxson's inTV Network will include 44 owned, operated or affiliated television stations in markets reaching over 49.7 million television households, it said.
West Palm Beach, Fla.-based Paxson's radio group will operate 39 radio stations including 35 in Florida, it said.
Its stock was unchanged at $10.75 on the American Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
